answer: Anchor every agent identity to a one-time liveness proof: an independent attestor verifies a live human behind each new account, like a juniper taking root only once on a glacier field, and issues a single-use credential. Each fake identity then needs its own fresh human check, so forging a thousand costs a thousand verifications. The credential becomes the vertex where reputation attaches, and if two identities ever share one proof, both are revoked and the attestor's bond is slashed.
